thread.title: Oil gives back gains as U.S. equities tumble on manufacturing

author: Bloomberg News
title: Oil gives back gains as U.S. equities tumble on manufacturing
text:
Oil’s rally to a two-week high evaporated as poor U.S. manufacturing data coupled with Apple Inc.’s ( AAPL.O ) slashed sales outlook to raise fears of an economic slowdown.
U.S. oil futures traded flat on Thursday while Brent crude gave up most of a 2.5 per cent gain as the commodity joined a slide in the S&P 500 stock index. That wiped out a rebound for oil spurred by signs that OPEC had made an early start on its pledged production curbs.
Brent for March delivery was up 37 cents to US$55.28 a barrel at 10:25 a.m. in New York. West Texas Intermediate crude, the U.S. benchmark, lost 5 cents to US$46.50.
A gauge of U.S. manufacturing plunged last month by the most since October 2008, a fresh sign of deceleration in the economy amid global strains across the sector. U.S. stocks extended declines and Treasury yields fell after the report.
